facts.businessType: Children's science, art and making workshop studio
facts.businessDescription: Toto STEAM Lab runs weekend and holiday workshops where children aged 6-12 build, experiment and make with real tools and materials: simple robotics kits, kitchen-science chemistry, printmaking and small woodwork. Groups are capped at eight children and led by trained facilitators in a purpose-built studio with proper workbenches.
facts.idealClientProfile: Parents of primary-school children in Nairobi looking for hands-on, screen-free enrichment activities. Decision maker: the parent. Website purpose: book a trial workshop session.
extraInformation: Positioning: curious, hands-on, joyful but orderly. Supporting message: real tools, real materials, real questions — screen-free making for curious kids.

Programs (exactly these four): Saturday Lab — rotating two-hour build and experiment sessions. Holiday Camps — week-long themed maker camps during school breaks. School Partnerships — curriculum-linked workshops delivered at partner schools. Birthday Builds — a group build project as a birthday party activity.
Things to emphasize: small groups of eight, trained facilitators, every child takes home what they build, all materials and safety gear provided.
Strict content constraints: do not invent testimonials, client names, awards, certifications, years in business, staff bios, pricing or any statistics. Never use real children's names or photos.

creativeDirection.direction: Toy-box workshop poster: a bright, chunky, screen-free maker feel — mustard yellow, tomato red and cobalt on warm cream, thick rounded outlines, big friendly shapes that look cut from coloured paper, and photos treated like snapshots taped into a scrapbook
creativeDirection.audience: Parents 28-45 in Nairobi choosing enrichment activities for primary-school children; they value safety, real learning and visible joy
creativeDirection.serviceEnvironment: A bright purpose-built studio with wooden workbenches; paint, wood, wheels and wires in active use
creativeDirection.preferredPalette: Mustard yellow #E8A93B, tomato red #D9532C, cobalt blue #2B5FB8, warm cream #FAF3E3, charcoal outline #2B2620
creativeDirection.visualStyle: Playful geometric poster: chunky rounded shapes with thick outlines, slightly rotated cards like paper cutouts, big friendly headline type, scrapbook photo treatment with taped corners
creativeDirection.tone: Warm, energetic, encouraging; playful but trustworthy — never childish chaos
creativeDirection.avoidances: No dark tech aesthetics, no purple gradients, no stock classroom photos, no generic rounded SaaS cards, no clip-art science beakers
creativeDirection.inspirationNotes: Mid-century toy packaging, paper cut-out collage, children's museum workshop posters, hand-painted shop signs
